TARGET: One ASURYANI MOUNTED or VYPER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
spirallingevasion.flavour: None but the Aeldari could risk such breakneck and seemingly suicidal evasive manoeuvres to jink around incoming enemy fire.

seerseye.name: SEER’S EYE
seerseye.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
seerseye.target: One AELDARI PSYKER model from your army and one friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit within 12" of it that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
seerseye.effect: Select one enemy unit visible to your PSYKER model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Armour Penetration and/or Damage characteristics of that attack.
seerseye.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One AELDARI PSYKER model from your army and one friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit within 12" of it that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit visible to your PSYKER model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Armour Penetration and/or Damage characteristics of that attack.
seerseye.flavour: Seeing their prey as much through the eyes of their guiding seer as with any sense of their own, the wraith constructs strike swift and true.

wraithbonearmour.name: WRAITHBONE ARMOUR
wraithbonearmour.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
wraithbonearmour.target: One WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units] that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
wraithbonearmour.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
wraithbonearmour.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units] that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
wraithbonearmour.flavour: The apparent fragility of wraith constructs’ lithe bodies be/ies their incredible resilience.

bladesfrombeyond.name: BLADES FROM BEYOND
bladesfrombeyond.target: One WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
bladesfrombeyond.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
bladesfrombeyond.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
bladesfrombeyond.flavour: Sometimes, the twinned perceptions of ghost warriors allow them to perceive - and strike at - the souls of their foes.

soulbridge.name: SOUL BRIDGE
soulbridge.target: One WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD or WRAITHLORD unit from your army and one ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.
soulbridge.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD or WRAITHLORD unit is considered to be within 12" of your PSYKER model for the purposes of the Psychic Guidance and Spirit Guides abilities.
soulbridge.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD or WRAITHLORD unit from your army and one ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.

EFFECT: Until the start of your next Command phase, your WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHGUARD or WRAITHLORD unit is considered to be within 12" of your PSYKER model for the purposes of the Psychic Guidance and Spirit Guides abilities.
soulbridge.flavour: It is risky for a Spiritseer to cast their awareness so far, but aiding the dead is sometimes necessary.

spirittoken.name: SPIRIT TOKEN
spirittoken.target: One WRAITHBLADES or WRAITHGUARD unit from your army.
spirittoken.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
spirittoken.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One WRAITHBLADES or WRAITHGUARD unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
spirittoken.flavour: By leaving psycho-resonant wraithbone markers upon the battlefield, these warriors wreathe vital strategic locations in an aura of dread not easily overcome.

crushingstrides.name: CRUSHING STRIDES
crushingstrides.when: Your Charge phase, just after a WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit from your army ends a Charge move.
crushingstrides.target: That WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit.
crushingstrides.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each WRAITHBLADES model in your unit, or roll four D6 if your unit has the WRAITHLORD keyword, or roll six D6 if your unit has the WRAITHKNIGHT keyword: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
crushingstrides.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after a WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That WRAITHBLADES, WRAITHLORD or WRAITHKNIGHT unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit and roll one D6 for each WRAITHBLADES model in your unit, or roll four D6 if your unit has the WRAITHLORD keyword, or roll six D6 if your unit has the WRAITHKNIGHT keyword: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
crushingstrides.flavour: Elegant they may be, but the weight and implacable strength of wraith constructs on the charge can smash enemies to the ground bloody and broken.

wardingsalvoes.name: WARDING SALVOES
wardingsalvoes.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
wardingsalvoes.target: One DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
wardingsalvoes.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
wardingsalvoes.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of one or more objective markers, you can re-roll the Wound roll.
wardingsalvoes.flavour: Woe betide the foe that seeks to claim the holdings of armed and determined Asuryani.

shieldnodes.name: SHIELD NODES
shieldnodes.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
shieldnodes.target: One DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
shieldnodes.effect: If your unit is within range of one or more objective markers, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
shieldnodes.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: If your unit is within range of one or more objective markers, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
shieldnodes.flavour: Exploiting a spar of old Aeldari technology, these warriors engage the flickering ghosts of ancient defensive force fields.

vaulsvengeance.name: VAUL’S VENGEANCE
vaulsvengeance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army.
vaulsvengeance.target: One WAR WALKERS unit from your army.
vaulsvengeance.effect: After that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).
vaulsvengeance.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
vaulsvengeance.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit destroys a DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army.

TARGET: One WAR WALKERS unit from your army.

EFFECT: After that enemy unit has finished making its attacks, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks, it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
vaulsvengeance.flavour: Swift and terrible vengeance comes for those who dare strike down the warriors of the Aeldari in the form of searing heavy weapons fire.

timetostrike.name: TIME TO STRIKE
timetostrike.target: One STORM GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
timetostrike.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
timetostrike.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One STORM GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit. Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
timetostrike.flavour: Storm Guardians train to recognise where and when their selfless aggression can best benefit their craftworld and never to miss such opportunities.

bladesofasuryan.name: BLADES OF ASURYAN
bladesofasuryan.target: One DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
bladesofasuryan.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
bladesofasuryan.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DIRE AVENGERS or GUARDIANS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.
bladesofasuryan.flavour: Asuryani martial teachings enable those wielding ranged weapons to employ them as close-quarter implements of death as well.

costofvictory.name: COST OF VICTORY
costofvictory.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
costofvictory.target: One GUARDIANS unit from your army.
costofvictory.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. When doing so, return every destroyed GUARDIANS model to your unit.
costofvictory.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One GUARDIANS unit from your army.

EFFECT: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. When doing so, return every destroyed GUARDIANS model to your unit.
costofvictory.flavour: In so desperate and vital a fight, the Aeldari must accept casualties they would normally avoid and even send fresh warriors in to bolster the flagging ranks if it means victory.

stageddeath.name: STAGED DEATH
stageddeath.target: One HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stageddeath.effect: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining.
stageddeath.restrictions: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
stageddeath.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: At the end of the phase, set your model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with half of its starting number of wounds remaining.

RESTRICTIONS: Each model can only be targeted with this Stratagem once per battle.
stageddeath.flavour: A feigned death and sudden, shocking return are as impactful as dismaying to the foe.

heroesfall.name: HEROES’ FALL
heroesfall.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
heroesfall.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
heroesfall.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
heroesfall.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
heroesfall.flavour: Though they may be slain, this step of the saedath calls on the players to act out the demise of tragic heroes who take their enemies with them to death.

mockingflight.name: MOCKING FLIGHT
mockingflight.when: Your Movement phase, just after a HARLEQUINS unit from your army Falls Back.
mockingflight.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
mockingflight.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a HARLEQUINS unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That HARLEQUINS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
mockingflight.flavour: The Harlequins tumble away in mock terror and panic before spinning back into the fight with cruel laughter and redoubled fury.

trickstersretort.name: TRICKSTERS’ RETORT
trickstersretort.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
trickstersretort.target: One TROUPE unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
trickstersretort.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
trickstersretort.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One TROUPE unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
trickstersretort.flavour: To the Harlequins, the foe are simply unwitting dance partners, their every move matched with graceful aplomb.

bloodydance.name: BLOODY DANCE
bloodydance.when: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
bloodydance.target: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.
bloodydance.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.
bloodydance.restrictions: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
bloodydance.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army that is within 6" of one or more enemy units and would be eligible to declare a charge against one or more of those enemy units if it were your Charge phase.

EFFECT: Your unit now declares a charge that only targets one or more of those enemy units, and you resolve that charge.

RESTRICTIONS: Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
bloodydance.flavour: Enemies goaded into following the steps of the saedath come unwittingly on cue to their executions.

exitthestage.name: EXIT THE STAGE
exitthestage.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
exitthestage.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
exitthestage.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
exitthestage.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
exitthestage.flavour: Players know when to fade back from the stage of war, ready to strike again when their moment comes.

pallofdread.name: PALL OF DREAD
pallofdread.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
pallofdread.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

EFFECT: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
pallofdread.flavour: Even after they fall, the most fervent Ynnari leave a sinister sense of watchfulness in their wake like some invisible death shroud.

macabreresilience.name: MACABRE RESILIENCE
macabreresilience.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
macabreresilience.target: One YNNARI INFANTRY or YNNARI MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

macabreresilience.text:

TARGET: One YNNARI INFANTRY or YNNARI MOUNTED unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
macabreresilience.flavour: Such is the conviction and power of the Ynnari that sometimes even mortal wounds cannot slow them.

emissariesofynnead.name: EMISSARIES OF YNNEAD
emissariesofynnead.when: Fight phase, just after a YNNARI INFANTRY unit from your army has selected its targets.
emissariesofynnead.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
emissariesofynnead.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a YNNARI INFANTRY unit from your army has selected its targets.

TARGET: That YNNARI INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If your unit is below its Starting Strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
emissariesofynnead.flavour: Immersed in murder and gripped by holy purpose, these warriors bring Ynnead’s fatal message and his final gift to all who face them.

partingtheveil.name: PARTING THE VEIL
partingtheveil.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
partingtheveil.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
partingtheveil.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

TARGET: One YNNARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
partingtheveil.flavour: In the moment of transcendent glory, before the Ynnari give their essence to their god, they fight harder than ever to take the foe with them to death.

soulsight.target: One YNNARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
soulsight.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One YNNARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
soulsight.flavour: Perceiving the flickering soulstuff of their foes, the Ynnari strike with ruthless precision.

deathanswersdeath.name: DEATH ANSWERS DEATH
deathanswersdeath.when: End of your opponent’s Shooting phase.
deathanswersdeath.target: One YNNARI unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units), if one or more models in that unit were destroyed this phase.
deathanswersdeath.effect: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase.
deathanswersdeath.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Shooting phase.

TARGET: One YNNARI unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units), if one or more models in that unit were destroyed this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase.
deathanswersdeath.flavour: As the foe slays their warriors, a terrible vigour grips the Ynnari and compels them to repay the slaughter in kind.

presentimentofdread.name: PRESENTIMENT OF DREAD
presentimentofdread.target: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.
presentimentofdread.effect: Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to your model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
presentimentofdread.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to your model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
presentimentofdread.flavour: The seer plucks fate to find the foe suffering a horrible death, then projects it into their minds.

forewarned.name: FOREWARNED
forewarned.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
forewarned.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
forewarned.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
forewarned.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
forewarned.flavour: Having foreseen already how this fight will play out, the seer projects their insights and warnings into the minds of the Aeldari who must fight it.

unshroudedtruth.name: UNSHROUDED TRUTH
unshroudedtruth.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to move this phase, was not set up on the battlefield this phase, and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
unshroudedtruth.effect:
- Place your unit in strategic reserves.

- Your unit has Deep Strike.

- Your unit must make an ingress move this phase.
unshroudedtruth.restrictions: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to be selected to move.
unshroudedtruth.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to move this phase, was not set up on the battlefield this phase, and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.

EFFECT:

- Place your unit in strategic reserves.

- Your unit has Deep Strike.

- Your unit must make an ingress move this phase.

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the phase, your unit is not eligible to be selected to move.
unshroudedtruth.flavour: Dispelling the psychosomatic mirage that has so far beguiled and assailed the foe, the seer reveals the true location of the warriors it was masquerading as.

fateinescapable.name: FATE INESCAPABLE
fateinescapable.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
fateinescapable.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
fateinescapable.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
fateinescapable.flavour: The Aeldari have already seen how best to lay low this enemy and strike in the sure knowledge the foe cannot evade their terrible fate.

ishasfury.name: ISHA’S FURY
ishasfury.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
ishasfury.target: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army within 9" of that enemy unit.
ishasfury.effect: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
ishasfury.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One ASURYANI PSYKER model from your army within 9" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
ishasfury.flavour: Leaping from the seer’s outstretched hand, this blast of empyric energy is a raw expression of the sorrow and bitterness suffered by the Aeldari people.

psychicshield.name: PSYCHIC SHIELD
psychicshield.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
psychicshield.target: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.
psychicshield.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
psychicshield.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASURYANI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is within 9" of one or more friendly ASURYANI PSYKER models.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
psychicshield.flavour: A twist of the seer's psychic powers raises a whirling shield of empyric energy and psychokinetic debris to screen the Aeldari from enemy fire.

warriorfocus.name: WARRIOR FOCUS
warriorfocus.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
warriorfocus.target: One ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
warriorfocus.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill, Weapon skill, Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
warriorfocus.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill, Weapon skill, Strength, Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
warriorfocus.flavour: So absolute is the focus of these warriors in battle that nothing can distract them or stay their blows.

totheirfinalbreath.name: TO THEIR FINAL BREATH
totheirfinalbreath.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
totheirfinalbreath.target: One ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
totheirfinalbreath.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
totheirfinalbreath.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
totheirfinalbreath.flavour: As champions and defenders of a dying race, these warriors fight furiously to the very end.

doominescapable.name: DOOM INESCAPABLE
doominescapable.target: One AVATAR OF KHAINE model from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
doominescapable.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model’s Wailing Doom ranged weapon has a Range characteristic of 18" and a Damage characteristic of 8.
doominescapable.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One AVATAR OF KHAINE model from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model’s Wailing Doom ranged weapon has a Range characteristic of 18" and a Damage characteristic of 8.
doominescapable.flavour: Cast with the force of a thunderbolt, the Avatar's weapon strikes the foe with meteoric force.

preternaturalprecision.name: PRETERNATURAL PRECISION
preternaturalprecision.target: One ASPECT WARRIORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
preternaturalprecision.effect: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, select one of the following abilities, or select two of the following abilities if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem: [IGNORES COVER], [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected abilities.
preternaturalprecision.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASPECT WARRIORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Each time you use this Stratagem, you can remove one Aspect Shrine token your unit has (see datasheets). Then, select one of the following abilities, or select two of the following abilities if you removed an Aspect Shrine token during this usage of this Stratagem: [IGNORES COVER], [LETHAL HITS], [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected abilities.
preternaturalprecision.flavour: Analysing their targets' weaknesses with incredible skill, the Aeldari fire for lethal effect.

khainesvengeance.name: KHAINE’S VENGEANCE
khainesvengeance.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.
khainesvengeance.target: One ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
khainesvengeance.effect: All models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
khainesvengeance.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One ASPECT WARRIORS or AVATAR OF KHAINE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: All models in that enemy unit must take a Desperate Escape test. When doing so, if that enemy unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from each of those tests.
khainesvengeance.flavour: Embodying the rage of Khaine himself, these warriors press home their attack and strike down those cowards who seek to flee their fury.

layeredwards.name: LAYERED WARDS
layeredwards.when: Any phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.
layeredwards.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
layeredwards.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
layeredwards.flavour: The wraithbone superstructure of this vehicle has been interlaced with warding runes, enabling its hull to resist incoming fire.

vectoredengines.name: VECTORED ENGINES
vectoredengines.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit makes a fall-back move.
vectoredengines.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
vectoredengines.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly AELDARI VEHICLE unit makes a fall-back move.

TARGET: That AELDARI VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
vectoredengines.flavour: The result of exquisite and ingenious Aeldari engineering, vectored engines enable grav vehicles to evade their enemies while maintaining accurate fire.

deceptivefeint.name: DECEPTIVE FEINT
deceptivefeint.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.
deceptivefeint.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
deceptivefeint.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.

TARGET: That HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".
deceptivefeint.flavour: Advancing foes assured of cutting the Harlequins down are often left thwarted with naught but a swirl of holofield shards where their prey once stood.

eldritchsuppression.name: ELDRITCH SUPPRESSION
eldritchsuppression.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
eldritchsuppression.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll if a model in that enemy unit was destroyed by those attacks.
eldritchsuppression.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.

TARGET: That RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll if a model in that enemy unit was destroyed by those attacks.
eldritchsuppression.flavour: Struck by a sudden volley of precision shots when no foe can be pinpointed can shake the resolve of the most stoic warriors.

castingbacktheveil.name: CASTING BACK THE VEIL
castingbacktheveil.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
castingbacktheveil.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
castingbacktheveil.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.

TARGET: That RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. That enemy unit has +6" detection range.
castingbacktheveil.flavour: Once these snipers have found their range to a shrouded foe with marksmen’s instincts and esoteric targeting technology, they swiftly pass this knowledge onto their allies.

nomadsofthehiddenway.name: NOMADS OF THE HIDDEN WAY
nomadsofthehiddenway.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.
nomadsofthehiddenway.effect:
- Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

- Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.
nomadsofthehiddenway.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit has shot.

TARGET: That RANGERS/SHROUD RUNNERS unit.

EFFECT:

- Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

- Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.
nomadsofthehiddenway.flavour: The unconstrained nomadism of a craftworld’s outcasts extends to the battlefield, such that few foes can respond before they melt back into hiding to hunt elsewhere.

presagedrehearsal.name: PRESAGED REHEARSAL
presagedrehearsal.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TROUPE unit is selected to fight.
presagedrehearsal.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TROUPE unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That TROUPE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].
presagedrehearsal.flavour: Amongst the performances of a saedath is the climactic sundering of monstrous foes or the enemy’s hateful barques, acts the Harlequins have long mastered.

captivatingperformance.name: CAPTIVATING PERFORMANCE
captivatingperformance.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
captivatingperformance.text:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly TROUPE unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
captivatingperformance.flavour: With the placement of sentinel nodes and a performance that echoes their guardianship of things lost to other Aeldari, the Harlequins guard well that which is sacred to them.

phantasmalmirage.name: PHANTASMAL MIRAGE
phantasmalmirage.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit has shot.
phantasmalmirage.effect:
- Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

- Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
phantasmalmirage.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit has shot.

TARGET: That HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT:

- Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

- Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
phantasmalmirage.flavour: The mirage launchers carried by a masque’s graceful craft can be triggered to produce haunting simulacra long enough to deceive the foe and allow a crew to manoeuvre away again to their next stage.

fangsofthebrood.name: FANGS OF THE BROOD
fangsofthebrood.target: One TROUPE unit from your army.
fangsofthebrood.effect: Until the end of the phase, when using your unit’s Dance of Death ability, you can select three of the abilities for your unit to gain, instead of one.
fangsofthebrood.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One TROUPE unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, when using your unit’s Dance of Death ability, you can select three of the abilities for your unit to gain, instead of one.
fangsofthebrood.flavour: Many are the heads of the brood, and many their fangs. As they spring and tumble over their foes, the Harlequins’ weapons echo the multiplicity of strikes unleashed by that mythic nest of snakes.

venomouswrath.name: VENOMOUS WRATH
venomouswrath.target: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
venomouswrath.effect: After your unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
venomouswrath.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: After your unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
venomouswrath.flavour: Embodying the serpent that strikes with blinding swiftness, this grav-skimmer lunges suddenly into range and unleashes its full fury on the foe.

strikingstride.name: STRIKING STRIDE
strikingstride.target: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army.
strikingstride.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
strikingstride.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One HARLEQUINS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
strikingstride.flavour: Springing between pillars and rubble, bounding forwards as though running on thin air, the Harlequins acrobatically hurl themselves into battle.

weaverscoils.name: WEAVERS’ COILS
weaverscoils.target: One HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
weaverscoils.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move of up to 6".
weaverscoils.text:
WHEN: End of your Fight phase.

TARGET: One HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.

EFFECT: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move. Otherwise, your unit can make a Fall Back move of up to 6".
weaverscoils.flavour: Inescapable yet impossible to catch, this unit personifies the ever-winding and incorporeal coils of the Skyweavers of myth.

weavingstride.name: WEAVING STRIDE
weavingstride.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
weavingstride.target: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
weavingstride.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
weavingstride.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
weavingstride.flavour: Maintaining their blistering pace, these warriors respond to their foes’ steps in the saedath with their own gravity-defying motions.

skywardlunge.name: SKYWARD LUNGE
skywardlunge.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
skywardlunge.target: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army.
skywardlunge.effect: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
skywardlunge.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One HARLEQUINS VEHICLE or HARLEQUINS MOUNTED unit from your army.

EFFECT: If your unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
skywardlunge.flavour: Like a serpent rearing back to strike at its prey anew, the Harlequins sweep high and appear to quit the field, ready to descend in fury a moment later.

raidersspoils.name: RAIDERS’ SPOILS
raidersspoils.target: One ANHRATHE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
raidersspoils.effect: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
raidersspoils.text:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One ANHRATHE unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Until the start of the next Command phase, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in your unit.
raidersspoils.flavour: Even as battle rages around them, the Eldritch Raiders prioritise the seizing of treasures above the destruction of their foes.

ruthlesskillers.name: RUTHLESS KILLERS
ruthlesskillers.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
ruthlesskillers.target: One CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or Fight this phase.
ruthlesskillers.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
ruthlesskillers.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One CORSAIR VOIDSCARRED unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or Fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
ruthlesskillers.flavour: These are Yriel’s chosen killers, and there is no escape for their prey.

yrielsexample.name: YRIEL’S EXAMPLE
yrielsexample.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
yrielsexample.target: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
yrielsexample.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
yrielsexample.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One AELDARI INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding WRAITH CONSTRUCT units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
yrielsexample.flavour: Inspired by their prince, who has felt Ynnead’s touch, the Eldritch Raiders laugh in the face of death.

nopreytoobig.name: NO PREY TOO BIG
nopreytoobig.target: One ANHRATHE, RANGERS or SHROUD RUNNERS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
nopreytoobig.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the highest Toughness characteristic of models in the target unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
nopreytoobig.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ANHRATHE, RANGERS or SHROUD RUNNERS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the highest Toughness characteristic of models in the target unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
nopreytoobig.flavour: By accurately targeting weak points in anatomies and superstructures, the Anhrathe can bring down even the most resilient of foes.

impedingfire.name: IMPEDING FIRE
impedingfire.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
impedingfire.target: One RANGERS, SHROUD RUNNERS or STARFANG unit from your army.
impedingfire.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) visible to and within 36" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
impedingfire.text:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.

TARGET: One RANGERS, SHROUD RUNNERS or STARFANG unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) visible to and within 36" of your unit. Until the end of the phase, each time that enemy unit declares a charge, subtract 2 from the Charge roll (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).
impedingfire.flavour: As the foes attempt to close in, Yriel’s cunning outcasts stymie their assault with a dazzling burst of distracting fire.

withdrawandreinforce.name: WITHDRAW AND REINFORCE
withdrawandreinforce.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
withdrawandreinforce.target: One ANHRATHE unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
withdrawandreinforce.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. If that unit is below Starting Strength, return all destroyed models (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit.
withdrawandreinforce.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One ANHRATHE unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
